title: Coast Guard medevacs elderly woman near Tenakee Springs, Alaska
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Sitka MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter aircrew works with Tenakee Springs Fire Department personnel and local emergency medical services personnel to medevac a 69-year-old woman who had suffered a leg injury and required medical care in Tenakee Springs, Alaska, June 6, 2020. The woman was safely transported to awaiting EMS in Sitka for further transport to a local hospital. U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Sitka.
